description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated nursing leader to oversee all aspects of patient care, ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance.

As the DON, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the resident experience and fostering a supportive environment for our nursing staff. This full-time position offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents and the success of our facility.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 3-5 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
Commitment to providing high-quality, compassionate patient care.
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000 per year, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time MDS Coordinator to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. This vital role offers a competitive hourly rate and the opportunity to significantly impact resident care and facility compliance.

The MDS Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and completing accurate resident assessments (MDS) in accordance with federal and state regulations. You will play a key role in developing comprehensive care plans, ensuring timely submissions, and contributing to the overall quality of care provided to our residents.
requirements: Prior experience as an MDS Coordinator, preferably with MDS 3.0
Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to resident assessment
Excellent clinical assessment and documentation skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00, based on experience.
